# google_parameter_manager_template_version

A Template Version resource that stores the actual content of the template.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about TemplateVersion, see:
* How-to Guides
    * [Parameter templates overview](https://cloud.google.com/secret-manager/parameter-manager/docs/parameter-templates-overview)

~> **Warning:** All arguments including the following potentially sensitive
values will be stored in the raw state as plain text: `template_data`.
[Read more about sensitive data in state](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/manage-sensitive-data).

## Example Usage - Template Version Basic


```hcl
resource "google_parameter_manager_template" "template-basic" {
  provider    = google-beta
  template_id = "template"
}

resource "google_parameter_manager_template_version" "template-version-basic" {
  provider            = google-beta
  template            = google_parameter_manager_template.template-basic.template_id
  template_version_id = "template-version"
  template_data       = "app: my-app\nenv: {{.env}}\n"
}
```

## Example Usage - Template Version With Json Format


```hcl
resource "google_parameter_manager_template" "template-basic" {
  provider    = google-beta
  template_id = "template"
  format      = "TEMPLATE_FORMAT_JSON"
}

resource "google_parameter_manager_template_version" "template-version-with-json-format" {
  provider            = google-beta
  template            = google_parameter_manager_template.template-basic.template_id
  template_version_id = "template-version"
  template_data = jsonencode({
    app = "my-app"
    env = "{{.env}}"
  })
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `template_data` -
  (Required)
  The Template data.
  **Note**: This property is sensitive and will not be displayed in the plan.

* `template` -
  (Required)
  ID of the Parameter Manager Template resource.

* `template_version_id` -
  (Required)
  Version ID of the Template Version Resource. This must be unique within the Template.


* `disabled` -
  (Optional)
  The current state of the Template Version. When set to `true`, the Template Version is
  disabled and API reads (including `terraform import` of an already-disabled version) omit
  `template_data` until re-enabled.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/global/templates/{{template}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the Template Version. Format:
  `projects/{{project}}/locations/global/templates/{{template}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}`

* `create_time` -
  The time at which the Template Version was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time at which the Template Version was updated.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


TemplateVersion can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/global/templates/{{template}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{template}}/{{template_version_id}}`
* `{{template}}/{{template_version_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import TemplateVersion using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    template = "<-required value->"
    templateVersionId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_parameter_manager_template_version.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import TemplateVersion using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/global/templates/{{template}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}"
  to = google_parameter_manager_template_version.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), TemplateVersion can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_parameter_manager_template_version.default projects/{{project}}/locations/global/templates/{{template}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}
$ terraform import google_parameter_manager_template_version.default {{project}}/{{template}}/{{template_version_id}}
$ terraform import google_parameter_manager_template_version.default {{template}}/{{template_version_id}}
```
